title: Is ros2 topic hz accurate at 1 kHz? hz and bw vs a C++ message counter, measured up to 10 kHz
excerpt: ros2 topic hz matched a C++ subscriber within 0.2% at 400 Hz and 1 kHz on Humble and Jazzy, and only topped out near 5 kHz on 2 vCPUs. Why ros2 topic bw disagrees (last 100 messages), and how to check a 1 kHz controller topic.
